paite: Huan Nun tapa Joshua in, "Agam leh Jeriko khua va en mah dih ua," chi in mi nih Sittim a pan asim a enkhe ding asawl hi. Ava hoh ua, kizuak khat, amin Rahab inn ah ava lut ua, huai ah ava zintung uhi.
heading: Joshua In Jeriko Ahvolirl Enkhe mite Asawl
english: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

paite: "Ngai in, tuzan in gam enkhe ding in Israel suante ahong uh," chi in Jeriko kumpipa hilh in a-om hi.
english: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”

paite: Jeriko kumpipa'n, "Na inn a hong tung mikhualte hon pekhia in. Gam pumpi enkhe ding a hong ahi uh," chỉ ding in Rahab kiang ah mi asawl hi.
english: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”

paite: Numei in huai mi nihte api a, asel a, akiang uah, "Hi, ka kiang ah mite ahong ngei ngut ua, himahleh koi a pan hong pai ahi ua, chih zaw ka thei kei.
heading: Enkhia Mi Nihte Humbitnar
english: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khomial, kulh kongpi khak hun lai in huai mite apawtkhe nawnta uh. Koilam ah ahia apai uh ka theita kei hi. Delh meng le uchin, na pha lai ding uh,” achi hi.
english: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

paite: Himahleh inn tung ah apitou a, inn tung a ziza kung siatkhawm lak a sel khin lah ahi ngal a.
english: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

paite: Mite'n Jordan lui lam ah, agalkaina tan in ava delh ua; adelh mite apawtkhiaktak un kulh kongpi akhak uhi.
english: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

paite: Alup ma un inn tung ah akiang uah ava hohtou hi.
heading: Enkhemite Lohchinna
english: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai gam TOUPA'N nou ahon peta, na lauhhuaina un hon delhkhum a, hiai gam a teng tengteng na ma uah azul khin uh, chih ka thei hi.
english: She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtkhiak un TOUPA'N Tuipi San ahon hihkangsak a, Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpi nih: Sihon leh Og tung a na hihdante uh, huchibang a na hihmangdante uh lah ka na zata ngal ua.
english: For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

paite: Huai ka na zaktak un, ka lungtangte uh azul khin a, noute ziak a lau lou himhim a-om kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian u lah tunglam van ah leh nuailam lei ah Pathian ahi.
english: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.

paite: "Tu in na tung uah ka hehpihna ka langsakta hi, nou leng ka pa inkote tung ah na hehpihna uh langsak sam un.
heading: Enkhe mite Leh Rahab Thukhun
english: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;

paite: Ka nu leh ka pa, ka sanggam pasalte, ka sanggam numeite leh aneih teng uh hawi unla, sihna lak a pan ka hinna uh hon humbitsak ding in TOUPA min in hehpih in ka kiang ah kichiam unla, chiamtehna dik hon pia un," achi hi.
english: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”

paite: Mite'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih uh na genkhiak kei dingleh na sih tang in ka si ding uh. Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N gam ahon piak hun chiang in, ka hon hehpih ding ua, na tung ah muanhuaitak in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when Yahweh gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”

paite: Tohlet ah khauhual azankhesuk a; khopi kulhbaang khou a a-inn om ahi a, huan amah kulhbaang tung a teng ahi.
english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.

paite: Akiang uah, "Tang lam zuan in pai un, huchi lou in zaw nou hon delhte'n ahon mu kha ding uh. Huai ah ni thum sung va kibu un; nou hon delhte ahong kik nawn masiah uh. Huai zoh chiang in na pai nawn na ding uh," achi hi.
english: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”

paite: Mite'n akiang ah, "Kichiamna a na hon kichiamsakna ah zaw dembei ka hi ding uh.
english: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.

paite: Ngai in, hiai gam ka hong lut chiang un na hon khiakna tohlet ah hiai khau san na gak belh în. Insung ah na kiang ah na pa, na nu, na sanggam teng leh na pa inkote tengteng pilut vek in.
english: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, na inn kongpi a pan kholak a pawtkhe peuhmah alutung ah asisan a-om dia, kou ahihleh moh in ka om kei ding uh. Kuapeuh insung a na kiang a om peuhmah atung ua khutkhak ahihleh, ka lutung uah asisan uh a-om ding hi.
english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.

paite: Himahleh ka thilhih uh na genkhiakleh na hon kichiamsakna ah moh in ka om kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na thu bang zel uh hi hen," achi a; huchi in amau akhakhia a, apaita uhi. Tohlet ah khau san agakden hi.
english: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.

paite: Apai ua, huai tang ava tung ua, huai ah ni thum, amau delhte akik nawn masiah uh ava om uhi. Adelh mite'n lamtawn in azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
heading: Enkhe mite Paikikna
english: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.

paite: Huai mi nihte akik nawn ua, huai tang a pan apaisuk ua, agalkah ua, Nun tapa Joshua kiang atung ua; atung ua thil tung tengteng ahilh uhi.
english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.

paite: Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agam pumpi i khut uah ahon na pe petmah ve, huai kia leng hilou, huai gam a tengte i ma uah azul khin uh," achi uhi.
english: They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”
